quote: To evaluate on the text generation task, We finetuned Gemma2-2b with our methods on MetaMathQA and evaluated on 5-shot GSM8K. Furthermore, for code generation tasks, we fine-tuned Llama3-8b with our methods and evaluated on the HumanEval and MBPP benchmarks.
...We fine-tuned Llama3-8b with our methods and evaluated on HumanEval and MBPP benchmarks. ...We also fine-tuned Gemma2-2b on MetaMathQA and evaluated on 5-shot GSM8K...

We fine-tuned Gemma2-2b on the MetaMathQA  dataset and evaluated on GSM8K (5-shots) to assess the models' multi-step mathematical reasoning ability. Furthermore, we fine-tuned Llama3-8b on the CodeFeedback , to evaluate on the HumanEval and MBPP which are aimed to test the code generation ability of models.
